AdSome people give up dessert in January. I’m definitely not one of those people🍦 

💌 Comment “YES!” for more dessert recipes with a nutritious twist!

Yes, I’m a nutritionist and yes, I still eat dessert. Ice cream everyday? OH GO ON THEN. Sometimes with a lil fibre boost, sometimes just because it’s plain old dessert!!! My current hyper fixation: The Ninja CREAMi

MY CURRENT FAV RECIPES:

🍏 Apple Pie Ice Cream
250g stewed apple (skin on - see video)
200g greek yoghurt (or plant-based alternative)
50ml milk of choice
1 tbsp honey / agave / syrup
1 tbsp ground oats
1 tsp cinnamon
pinch of salt
Method: Blend everything until smooth, pour into your Ninja Creami tub, freeze for 24 hours, then spin on the ice cream setting

🍌 Banana & Vanilla Froyo
2 large ripe bananas
100g greek yoghurt (or plant-based alternative)
100ml milk of choice (I used vanilla soy)
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 tbsp maple syrup
Pinch of salt
Method: Blend all ingredients until silky, freeze in your Creami tub for 24 hours, then spin on the frozen yoghurt setting

🍫 Chocolate Date Soft Serve
250g greek yoghurt (or plant-based alternative)
50ml milk of choice
2 Medjool dates (pitted)
1.5 tbsp cocoa powder
2 tbsp maple syrup
Pinch of salt
Method: Blend everything until smooth, freeze in the Creami tub for 24 hours, then spin on soft serve setting

OPTIONAL fibre boosts:  chia seeds, oats, flaxseed, coconut flakes, cocoa nibs or berries

SAVE AND ENJOY!

@NinjaKitchenuk #CreamiDiet  #NINJACREAMi #healthyrecipes

ad Not bread… make my potato wrap instead!

The ultimate gf and plant based BLT with @ninjakitchenuk - saving time and effort with their containers that you can prep, cook and store in. Making this potato ‘wrap’ took just 8 minutes with the roast function, but you can pretty much cook anything with their airfry, recrisp and keep warm functions 🧚🏼‍♀️

Makes 1 ‘BLT’
For the bacon
1/2 block smoked tofu
1 tbsp tamari
1 tbsp maple syrup
1/2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tbsp olive oil
Salt and pepper

For the wrap
1 small potato
15g vegan cheddar

To build
Handful shredded lettuce
1 tomato, sliced
1 tbsp vegan mayo

Using a mandolin on the thicker setting, thinly slice ½ block of smoked tofu. Add into the smaller Crispi container along with the remaining ingredients. Add the lid, shake the container to mix and place into the fridge to marinade until ready to cook. Snap on the Crispi lid and air fry for 10–12 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp and caramelised.

Thinly slice the potato using the thinnest setting on the mandolin. Add a layer of greaseproof into the larger Crispi basket, tucking in the edges so it doesn’t fly away! Arrange the slices in a slightly overlapping square pattern to form a flat wrap shape. Sprinkle over the vegan cheddar, season and drizzle with a little oil. Snap the lid on and roast for 8 minutes or until golden and crisp.

Carefully remove the potato wrap from the Crispi once it has cooled for 2 minutes. Spread with vegan mayo, then layer on the shredded lettuce, tomato slices, and tofu bacon. Fold or roll gently to serve.

And the Ninja CRISPi is only £149 on ninjakitchen.co.uk!

#crispisavestheday

body:
We made a protein packed cereal milk sort serve with our new Ninja Creami Swirl🍦.

Recipe:

Ingredients:

• 400ml of milk
- 70g 1 of frosted flakes
- ⁠1 scoop of vanilla protein powder
- ⁠1/4 teaspoon of Xanthan Gum powder.
- ⁠1/4 teaspoon of vanilla essence
- ⁠pinch of salt

Instructions:

Step 1: Combine milk & cereal together and leave to soak for 3-4 hours.

Step 2: Use a sieve to separate the cornflakes from the milk and add the milk to the Creami tub.

Step 3: Mix in in the remaining ingredients to the tub and freeze for 24hrs.

Step 4: After 24 hours, attach the tub to the Ninja Creami and select “Soft Serve” then select “Lite Ice Cream”.

Step 5: Once completed attach the tub to the soft serve dispenser to create your own soft serve swirl and enjoy!

Bonus tip- Garnish your ice cream with more corn flakes for a little added crunch.

@ninjakitchenuk 

#CREAMidiet

body:
AD | Meal prep that actually works with @ninjakitchenuk

This 1.6kg chicken gave me 4 days of crispy, juicy meals - made in one machine, in a tiny kitchen.

The Ninja Crispi air fried it in about 60 minutes, and now all I do is hit “Recrisp” for 5–10 minutes each night. Dinner’s done. Fresh salad on the side. 10 minutes total.

The trick? A killer marinade and knowing when to cover the top with foil if it starts browning too fast.

Here’s the marinade I used
• ¼ cup avocado oil
• Juice of ½ lemon
• 1 tbsp Dijon mustard
• 1 tbsp each garlic & onion powder
• 1 tbsp smoked paprika
• 3 tbsp Italian seasoning
• 1 tsp each chili powder, allspice & black pepper
• 1 tbsp fresh rosemary + oregano
• 1 tsp salt

Roast to 73°C next to the bone and let it rest before carving.
One cook. Four meals. Would you try this?

#CRISPiSavesTheDay

AD | As it’s Burns Night this week, we used the Ninja Creami Swirl to put our own twist on a traditional Cranachan dessert 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 . Those doing Dry Jan don’t need to miss out as our recipe is alcohol free!

Recipe:

Ingredients:

- 1 cup raspberries (plus some extra for garnish)
- ⁠200ml milk
- ⁠1 tablespoon of honey
- ⁠1 tablespoon of yoghurt
- ⁠1/2 teaspoon of vanilla extract
- ⁠1/4 teaspoon Xanthan gum powder
- ⁠Pinch of salt
- ⁠1/4 cup of toasted oats

Instructions:

Step 1: Blend the milk and 1 cup of raspberries together until smooth.

Step 2: Add the blended ingredients into the Ninja Creami tub along with the Xanthan gum, honey, salt and vanilla and mix.

Step 3: Freeze the tub for 24hrs.

Step 4: After 24 hours, attach the tub to the Ninja Creami and select “Soft Serve” then select “Lite Ice Cream”.

Step 5: Once completed, attach the tub to the soft serve dispenser to create your own soft serve swirl.

Step 6: Add your toasted oats and some fresh raspberries on top of your swirl and enjoy.

Bonus tip: You can drizzle extra honey on top of your swirl if you like it nice and sweet 🍯.

@ninjauk

#CREAMiDiet

4 lunches for £6 ~ Crispi Beef & Broccoli Noodle Bowls 🥦 AD
 
These high-protein noodle bowls are loaded with flavour and couldn’t be easier, thanks to the Ninja Crispi. From storage, to prep, to cleaning- they’ve thought of everything. I love that the base of the crispi containers are designed for reheating, which is then separated by the crisper plate, where you add all of your ingredients that you want a crispy, caramelised result. I love portioning out the individual containers for my meal prep so that all my lunches are ready for the week and I can just grab them from the fridge and cook for 5 minutes. Plus when I’m done I can just throw it in the dishwasher!
 
Ingredients 
500g beef mince (£3.50)
1 head of broccoli, florets and stalks sliced (£0.47)
200g noodles (£1.45)
Fresh coriander, chopped to serve (£0.52)
 
Cupboard Essentials 
For the noodles: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp honey. For the beef, 1 tbsp cornflour, 1 tsp garlic granules, 1 tsp honey, 1 tbsp soy sauce. 
 
Method
1. Add your noodles and broccoli to salted water and cook for 5 minutes. Drain and coat in the ingredients for the noodles. Also combine the cupboard ingredients with the beef until fully incorporated. 
2. Divide the noodles/broccoli into the base of the Ninja crisp containers. Add the crisper plate, then add a layer of seasoned beef mince. Use the lid to seal then place in the fridge when cool enough. 
3. When it’s time to eat, simply remove the lid and place the Ninja crisp onto the container. Airfry for 5-7 minutes, then serve with a sprinkle of coriander and enjoy! 
 
@ninjakitchenuk #mealprep #budgetmeals #ninjacrispi

Ad CRISPi ran the kitchen today. I just showed up.

Breakfast: Air Fried Frittata
3 whole eggs 2 egg whites 1/4 cup low-fat cottage cheese 1/4 cup diced bell peppers 1/4 cup chopped spinach Salt and pepper to taste Whisk all ingredients together. Cook in Ninja Crispi on air fry for 15 to 20 minutes, mixing every 5 minutes until set and lightly golden. Let cool before slicing.

Lunch: Chicken and Veggie Bowl 1 large skinless chicken breasts, diced 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp paprika 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 cup broccoli florets 1/2 cup chopped carrots Salt and pepper to taste Toss chicken with oil and spices. Cook on air fry for 10 minutes. Add broccoli and carrots and cook another 10 minutes until chicken is cooked and vegetables are tender. Serve with brown rice or quinoa.

Dinner: High-Protein Turkey Cheeseburger
500g lean ground turkey (93%)
Half grated onion
1 teaspoons Dijon mustard
1 cloves garlic, minced
1 teaspoon onion powder
1 teaspoon Italian seasoning (optional)
1 teaspoon salt
½ teaspoon black pepper
2 slices reduced-fat cheddar cheese
Mix all ingredients except cheese and form 4 patties. Cook in Ninja Crispi on air fry for 10 to 13 minutes, flipping halfway, until cooked through. In final minute, place a slice of cheese on each patty and close lid to melt. Let rest 2 minutes before serving.

body:
AD | caramelised banana bread iced latte with a banana bread cold foam cause summer isn’t over yet 😏

jess a cuppa has opened again and now featuring a brand-new gorgeous coffee machine to help me creative some amazing coffees 😍

@ninjakitchenuk Ninja Luxe Café pro is a 3 in 1 coffee machine that grinds, scales and tamps PLUS it’s got loads of customisable drink options meaning cafe-quality drinks at home 🙂‍↕️ and my FAV feature, where you can create creamyy cold foam while brewing your espresso at the same time! 

recipe 

caramelised banana syrup:

1 tbsp butter
2 bananas, chopped
½ cup dark brown sugar
½ cup light brown sugar 
1 cup water
1 tsp maple syrup
½ tsp cinnamon powder
¼ tsp nutmeg or can omit if don’t have 
Pinch salt 
1 tbsp vanilla extract

method:

- melt butter in a pan then add in chopped bananas and fry until both sides start to brown
- add brown sugar in stages and mix into the bananas 
- once fully mixed in, add water and mix
- add cinnamon powder, nut meg, pinch of salt, maple syrup & bring to a boil then simmer for 10 mins
- here you can strain to only get the syrup or let cool before adding vanilla extract and blending until smooth (can add a bit more water if necessary)
store in fridge for up to 2 weeks 
 
cold foam:

2 tbsp double cream
1 tbsp milk
1 heaped tsp banana bread syrup 

toppings: cinnamon & pan-fried banana slices 

#NinjaLuxeCafe #ninjakitchenuk #bananabreadsyrup #homecafe #icedlatte #espresso

body:
PISTACHIO, MISO + BANANA SOFT SERVE 🍦 

as you MIGHT have noticed, I’m not normally one to make desserts or anything sweet. but when an opportunity arose to make homemade ice cream, but healthier, I couldn’t resist 👀

ad @ninjakitchenuk asked me to make a summery soft serve in their new Swirl machine, so I decided to go for a pistachio, miso, tahini + banana flavoured - made healthier with coconut milk + maple syrup. and it was ABSOLUTELY delicious 🤤 

this was my ice cream of choice - but you can get super creative with your flavours, toppings + ice cream type 🍨

for my ice cream mix, I simply blended: 1 can (400ml) coconut milk, 1 banana, 100g toasted pistachios, 1 tbsp tahini, 1 tsp miso paste, 80g maple syrup + a pinch of salt. Then followed the Ninja Swirl instructions 🤓

but tell me, would you give my recipe a go? let me know in the comments below 👇 

#icecream #softserve #homemadeicecream #easyrecipes #summerrecipes #NinjaSwirl

body:
PISTACHIO, MISO + BANANA SOFT SERVE 🍦 

as you MIGHT have noticed, I’m not normally one to make desserts or anything sweet. but when an opportunity arose to make homemade ice cream, but healthier, I couldn’t resist 👀

ad @ninjakitchenuk asked me to make a summery soft serve in their new Swirl machine, so I decided to go for a pistachio, miso, tahini + banana flavoured - made healthier with coconut milk + maple syrup. and it was ABSOLUTELY delicious 🤤 

this was my ice cream of choice - but you can get super creative with your flavours, toppings + ice cream type 🍨

for my ice cream mix, I simply blended: 1 can (400ml) coconut milk, 1 banana, 100g toasted pistachios, 1 tbsp tahini, 1 tsp miso paste, 80g maple syrup + a pinch of salt. Then followed the Ninja Swirl instructions 🤓

but tell me, would you give my recipe a go? let me know in the comments below 👇 

#icecream #softserve #homemadeicecream #easyrecipes #summerrecipes #NinjaSwirl

Treating myself to hot bubble bath and taking my time getting ready before heading out for a romantic dinner for two with Stephen. He even surprised me with a little sparkle, which never goes unappreciated! 🥰 

Simple, cosy, and perfect for a day with my favourite person.

body:
We made a protein packed cereal milk sort serve with our new Ninja Creami Swirl🍦.

Recipe:

Ingredients:

• 400ml of milk
- 70g 1 of frosted flakes
- ⁠1 scoop of vanilla protein powder
- ⁠1/4 teaspoon of Xanthan Gum powder.
- ⁠1/4 teaspoon of vanilla essence
- ⁠pinch of salt

Instructions:

Step 1: Combine milk & cereal together and leave to soak for 3-4 hours.

Step 2: Use a sieve to separate the cornflakes from the milk and add the milk to the Creami tub.

Step 3: Mix in in the remaining ingredients to the tub and freeze for 24hrs.

Step 4: After 24 hours, attach the tub to the Ninja Creami and select “Soft Serve” then select “Lite Ice Cream”.

Step 5: Once completed attach the tub to the soft serve dispenser to create your own soft serve swirl and enjoy!

Bonus tip- Garnish your ice cream with more corn flakes for a little added crunch.

@ninjakitchenuk 

#CREAMidiet

body:
#AD Home Cooking Sessions with @ninjakitchenuk : Smoked bone-in ribeye and roasted bone marrow, with burnt shallot beef jus. A beautiful plate built around smoke and fire, all cooked outside on my Ninja FlexFlame. #NinjaFlexFlame
 -
For this one I wanted to build something with real depth, starting with a proper beef jus. Shallots, garlic, lemon and bavette charred hard over high heat, then simmered with red wine and beef stock. Reduced right down until thick, glossy and intensely flavoured, finished with butter and the charred lemon. The perfect steak sauce.
 
For the ribeye, I started with a hard sear to build the crust, then moved it over to a lower heat to smoke, picking up a deep colour and that woody aroma from the Ninja Woodfire pellets. Bone marrow went in alongside, cooked until soft and bubbling.
 
It’s a rich plate, so I kept the garnish sharp and simple – a parsley, shallot and caper salad to cut through.
 
The FlexFlame makes it easy to move between smoking and high heat searing without switching setups, so you can layer flavour properly and cook everything in one place. Big cuts, simple technique, proper results.

body:
4 lunches for £6 ~ Crispi Beef & Broccoli Noodle Bowls 🥦 AD
 
These high-protein noodle bowls are loaded with flavour and couldn’t be easier, thanks to the Ninja Crispi. From storage, to prep, to cleaning- they’ve thought of everything. I love that the base of the crispi containers are designed for reheating, which is then separated by the crisper plate, where you add all of your ingredients that you want a crispy, caramelised result. I love portioning out the individual containers for my meal prep so that all my lunches are ready for the week and I can just grab them from the fridge and cook for 5 minutes. Plus when I’m done I can just throw it in the dishwasher!
 
Ingredients 
500g beef mince (£3.50)
1 head of broccoli, florets and stalks sliced (£0.47)
200g noodles (£1.45)
Fresh coriander, chopped to serve (£0.52)
 
Cupboard Essentials 
For the noodles: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp honey. For the beef, 1 tbsp cornflour, 1 tsp garlic granules, 1 tsp honey, 1 tbsp soy sauce. 
 
Method
1. Add your noodles and broccoli to salted water and cook for 5 minutes. Drain and coat in the ingredients for the noodles. Also combine the cupboard ingredients with the beef until fully incorporated. 
2. Divide the noodles/broccoli into the base of the Ninja crisp containers. Add the crisper plate, then add a layer of seasoned beef mince. Use the lid to seal then place in the fridge when cool enough. 
3. When it’s time to eat, simply remove the lid and place the Ninja crisp onto the container. Airfry for 5-7 minutes, then serve with a sprinkle of coriander and enjoy! 
 
@ninjakitchenuk #mealprep #budgetmeals #ninjacrispi

I think I have a new favourite toy @ninjakitchenuk 🤣 this thing can turn almost anything into ice cream! I fear I may have to take up that challenge… 👀 Lemme know if you have any flavour suggestions 🙊

I made homemade cookies and cream ice cream, that was so easy and tasted incredible!
I also made frozen Greek yoghurt soft serve, that has 39g of protein per pint, which also tasted amazing! 🙌

I’ll always believe you can enjoy ice cream every day, no rules, no guilt. What I love about The Swirl is how it makes staying aligned with your goals so easy and flexible, without taking the joy out of dessert 🤌

Recipes below:

Cookies & cream ice cream:
60g caster sugar
20g cream cheese
2 tsp vanilla
165ml double cream
250ml whole milk
3 cookies & cream biscuits, broken

Frozen yoghurt soft serve:
430g Greek yoghurt (5% fat)
3 tbsp honey
2 tsp vanilla
50ml whole milk
Toppings: frozen blueberries, melted in the microwave, granola & honey

Enjoy!

body:
4 lunches for £6 ~ Crispi Beef & Broccoli Noodle Bowls 🥦 AD
 
These high-protein noodle bowls are loaded with flavour and couldn’t be easier, thanks to the Ninja Crispi. From storage, to prep, to cleaning- they’ve thought of everything. I love that the base of the crispi containers are designed for reheating, which is then separated by the crisper plate, where you add all of your ingredients that you want a crispy, caramelised result. I love portioning out the individual containers for my meal prep so that all my lunches are ready for the week and I can just grab them from the fridge and cook for 5 minutes. Plus when I’m done I can just throw it in the dishwasher!
 
Ingredients 
500g beef mince (£3.50)
1 head of broccoli, florets and stalks sliced (£0.47)
200g noodles (£1.45)
Fresh coriander, chopped to serve (£0.52)
 
Cupboard Essentials 
For the noodles: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp honey. For the beef, 1 tbsp cornflour, 1 tsp garlic granules, 1 tsp honey, 1 tbsp soy sauce. 
 
Method
1. Add your noodles and broccoli to salted water and cook for 5 minutes. Drain and coat in the ingredients for the noodles. Also combine the cupboard ingredients with the beef until fully incorporated. 
2. Divide the noodles/broccoli into the base of the Ninja crisp containers. Add the crisper plate, then add a layer of seasoned beef mince. Use the lid to seal then place in the fridge when cool enough. 
3. When it’s time to eat, simply remove the lid and place the Ninja crisp onto the container. Airfry for 5-7 minutes, then serve with a sprinkle of coriander and enjoy! 
 
@ninjakitchenuk #mealprep #budgetmeals #ninjacrispi

body:
AdSome people give up dessert in January. I’m definitely not one of those people🍦 

💌 Comment “YES!” for more dessert recipes with a nutritious twist!

Yes, I’m a nutritionist and yes, I still eat dessert. Ice cream everyday? OH GO ON THEN. Sometimes with a lil fibre boost, sometimes just because it’s plain old dessert!!! My current hyper fixation: The Ninja CREAMi

MY CURRENT FAV RECIPES:

🍏 Apple Pie Ice Cream
250g stewed apple (skin on - see video)
200g greek yoghurt (or plant-based alternative)
50ml milk of choice
1 tbsp honey / agave / syrup
1 tbsp ground oats
1 tsp cinnamon
pinch of salt
Method: Blend everything until smooth, pour into your Ninja Creami tub, freeze for 24 hours, then spin on the ice cream setting

🍌 Banana & Vanilla Froyo
2 large ripe bananas
100g greek yoghurt (or plant-based alternative)
100ml milk of choice (I used vanilla soy)
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 tbsp maple syrup
Pinch of salt
Method: Blend all ingredients until silky, freeze in your Creami tub for 24 hours, then spin on the frozen yoghurt setting

🍫 Chocolate Date Soft Serve
250g greek yoghurt (or plant-based alternative)
50ml milk of choice
2 Medjool dates (pitted)
1.5 tbsp cocoa powder
2 tbsp maple syrup
Pinch of salt
Method: Blend everything until smooth, freeze in the Creami tub for 24 hours, then spin on soft serve setting

OPTIONAL fibre boosts:  chia seeds, oats, flaxseed, coconut flakes, cocoa nibs or berries

SAVE AND ENJOY!

@NinjaKitchenuk #CreamiDiet  #NINJACREAMi #healthyrecipes

body:
AD | As it’s Burns Night this week, we used the Ninja Creami Swirl to put our own twist on a traditional Cranachan dessert 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 . Those doing Dry Jan don’t need to miss out as our recipe is alcohol free!

Recipe:

Ingredients:

- 1 cup raspberries (plus some extra for garnish)
- ⁠200ml milk
- ⁠1 tablespoon of honey
- ⁠1 tablespoon of yoghurt
- ⁠1/2 teaspoon of vanilla extract
- ⁠1/4 teaspoon Xanthan gum powder
- ⁠Pinch of salt
- ⁠1/4 cup of toasted oats

Instructions:

Step 1: Blend the milk and 1 cup of raspberries together until smooth.

Step 2: Add the blended ingredients into the Ninja Creami tub along with the Xanthan gum, honey, salt and vanilla and mix.

Step 3: Freeze the tub for 24hrs.

Step 4: After 24 hours, attach the tub to the Ninja Creami and select “Soft Serve” then select “Lite Ice Cream”.

Step 5: Once completed, attach the tub to the soft serve dispenser to create your own soft serve swirl.

Step 6: Add your toasted oats and some fresh raspberries on top of your swirl and enjoy.

Bonus tip: You can drizzle extra honey on top of your swirl if you like it nice and sweet 🍯.

@ninjauk

#CREAMiDiet

body:
AD Food you can eat with your hands at a supperclub is always a fun idea in my opinion - the messier the better!! I made these delicious buffalo drumsticks with a blue cheese sauce in the new @ninjakitchenuk CRISPi Pro for friends recently and they went down a treat! It’s bigger and better and with all that space it makes it easy to cook en masse! You could even serve the food in the air fryer container if you wanted to!#ninjacrispipro 

Ingredients:
1kg drumsticks 
2 tbsp cornflour
1 tbsp plain flour 
1 tsp paprika 
1 tsp chilli powder
salt and pepper

Buffalo Sauce:
250ml hot sauce 
1 knob of butter 
1 clove of garlic 

Blue Cheese Sauce:
150g Blue cheese 
60-70ml milk 
knob of butter 
150ml sour cream

Spring onion and Celery to serve 

Method:
Dry the drumsticks with paper towel and then coat them in the flour/spice mix. Place in an even layer at the bottom of the Ninja CRISPi Pro and air fry for 15-20 minutes at 200C flipping halfway. 

Meanwhile, melt butter in a pan and add minced garlic and then hot sauce. Remove from the heat and set aside.

Melt butter, milk and blue cheese in a pan and then leave to cool for a few minutes before stirring into sour cream. 

Once the chicken is done, toss it in the buffalo hot sauce and serve on a platter with the blue cheese sauce, celery and a sprinkling of spring onions.

AD Food you can eat with your hands at a supperclub is always a fun idea in my opinion - the messier the better!! I made these delicious buffalo drumsticks with a blue cheese sauce in the new @ninjakitchenuk CRISPi Pro for friends recently and they went down a treat! It’s bigger and better and with all that space it makes it easy to cook en masse! You could even serve the food in the air fryer container if you wanted to!#ninjacrispipro 

Ingredients:
1kg drumsticks 
2 tbsp cornflour
1 tbsp plain flour 
1 tsp paprika 
1 tsp chilli powder
salt and pepper

Buffalo Sauce:
250ml hot sauce 
1 knob of butter 
1 clove of garlic 

Blue Cheese Sauce:
150g Blue cheese 
60-70ml milk 
knob of butter 
150ml sour cream

Spring onion and Celery to serve 

Method:
Dry the drumsticks with paper towel and then coat them in the flour/spice mix. Place in an even layer at the bottom of the Ninja CRISPi Pro and air fry for 15-20 minutes at 200C flipping halfway. 

Meanwhile, melt butter in a pan and add minced garlic and then hot sauce. Remove from the heat and set aside.

Melt butter, milk and blue cheese in a pan and then leave to cool for a few minutes before stirring into sour cream. 

Once the chicken is done, toss it in the buffalo hot sauce and serve on a platter with the blue cheese sauce, celery and a sprinkling of spring onions.

body:
AD | NINJA CRISPI PRO – PORK BELLY

Ingredients:
(Serves 4)

800g Pork belly
500g Ratte potatoes
1 Fennel
50g Olive oil
15g Garlic (4 cloves)
125ml White wine
120g Crème fraîche
40g Dijon mustard
8g Dill, chopped
Salt + pepper

Cut the vegetables and place the fennel on the base of the Ninja Crispi, then add the potatoes, season, and add the garlic, white wine, and olive oil. Place the seasoned pork belly on top.

Cook on roast at 140°C for 2 hours. After 2 hours, switch the Ninja Crispi Pro to Max Crisp and cook for a further 10 minutes until the crackling has puffed up. Carve the pork and serve.

APPLE TART

6 Pink Lady apples
100g softened butter
100g caster sugar
1 sheet puff pastry

Peel the apples, cut in half, and remove the cores. If possible, leave the apples to dry at room temperature for about an hour.

Make a caramel using the butter and pour it into the base of the @ninjakitcheuk Crispi Pro dish. Position the apples on top, unroll the puff pastry, and place it over the apples, tucking the pastry down the sides. Cut a small hole in the centre of the pastry.

Set the Ninja Crispi Pro to bake mode at 180°C and cook for 50 minutes. Once cooked, leave it in the pan for 5 minutes to rest before turning out and portioning.

#NinjaCrispiPro

The Ninja Crispi Pro does all the work so you can hang with your friends. Prep, Cook and Serve. Check out the recipe ⬇️ 

Hot Honey Chipotle Salmon Tacos with Tajin Butter Corn and Burnt Salsa 

INGREDIENTS 

For the salmon 
500g side of salmon 2 tbsp chipotle paste 1 tsp coriander seeds 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp Sichuan peppercorns, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp MSG, 1 tbsp honey. 

For the burnt salsa 
400g cherry tomatoes, 1 onion, roughly chopped, 6 garlic cloves, 2 red chillies, halved, 1 handful coriander Juice of 2 limes, Salt. 

For the Tajin butter corn 
4 corn cobs, 2 tbsp softened butter, 1 tsp Tajin, Zest and juice of 1 lime, Salt. 

For the avocado & cucumber salad 
1 cucumber, diced, 1 avocado, diced, 10g coriander, chopped, Juice of 1 lime, Salt 

To serve 
4–6 small tortillas 
Extra Tajin Sliced spring onions
